defining.label: Naxos or Paros (Portara, Chora, Naoussa, Lefkes)
A further Cycladic island (Milos, Sifnos, Folegandros, Mykonos, Tinos, Ios)

redFlags.label: A timed drive between two islands (no road joins them)

notes: Island-hopping is by ferry between islands; each island moves by bus, scooter, taxi or a short hire. Any inter-island leg must be a crossing (ferry), never a timed drive. Written 2026-11-15 before any run.

defining.label: Game drives in at least two distinct parks or reserves
Makgadikgadi / Nxai Pans, Central Kalahari or a Victoria Falls side trip

redFlags.label: A self-drive hire car on an operator-led safari
Built around a town (Maun, Kasane, Gaborone) rather than the parks

notes: Usually Maun and Kasane as gateways with nights in or beside the Okavango Delta/Moremi and Chobe; light-aircraft transfers between delta camps; operator vehicles. Written 2026-11-15 before any run.
